Implemented next -n N over currently eligible started then open items, ranked by effective score with stable ties; preserved output formats and added invalid/exhausted offset handling. Focused coverage and full suite passed: 536 tests, 1 optional skip; slicer check and git diff --check passed.

Documented a no-clone install (venv + pip install git+https://…, with pip --user quick option noting PEP 668/PATH caveats, and a pipx/uv mention) alongside the clone/editable path in README, getting-started, and AGENTS; added tests/test_packaging.py guarding the templates package-data + slicer entry point + bundled-template loading. Verified locally: built and installed from source into a throwaway venv and ran slicer/ai instructions/init/render/check outside any checkout (templates shipped). 539 tests + slicer check + git diff --check pass. PyPI deferred to S06 (name 'slicer' is taken).

Added a persistent shortcut strip to the normal TUI browsing view: common actions (Tab/e/a/s/d, /, f, c, g, j/k, ?, q) derived from BINDINGS, packed into one row when they fit or two at 80x10, shown only in normal mode and reserved below the status and feedback rows so feedback never hides them. Full help (?) unchanged. 544 tests (5 new) + slicer check + git diff --check pass; shortcut packing verified at 80/100/160 cols.

Added 'ui' as a true argparse alias of 'tui' (extended the add() helper with aliases=; both share cmd_tui, project discovery, options, error handling, exit code, and --json rejection; lazy curses import preserved). Top-level help shows 'tui (ui)'. Updated README/agents/getting-started to name tui/ui as the --json exception. Four focused CLI tests (dispatch, explicit --root, help without opening curses, identical --json rejection); 548 tests + slicer check + git diff --check pass.

move --to now refuses a position outside 1..len(items) with a StateError naming the range (code=usage, exit 2), replacing the silent clamp; the popped item is reinserted before raising so a rejected move leaves the queue unchanged. Moving to the last position still works. Four focused test_ops.py tests (zero, negative, beyond-end with order preserved, last position). 552 tests + slicer check + git diff --check pass.
Parallel branches conflict on .slicer/log.jsonl and generated render/ files

Added a read-only 'slicer find PATTERN [--in FIELDS] [--json]' verb: case-insensitive substring search over id/title/short_title/findings and slice body (boundary+lead+section headings/bodies) by default, --in narrows, output/JSON identical to list via a shared _item_rows helper. Unknown --in field and empty pattern exit 2 (code=usage). TUI search was delivered by S41; this adds the CLI side. New tests/test_find.py (10 tests); README/agents/getting-started updated. 562 tests + slicer check + git diff --check pass.

init writes .slicer/.gitattributes marking log.jsonl merge=union (git's built-in union driver; portable, no per-clone config), so parallel branches combine appended history without conflict; slicer log now sorts by timestamp (newest first, later-appended breaking ties) so union-interleaved lines still read in order. render/ handling is documented (resolve index.json, slicer render; check catches staleness) rather than a merge driver, which was considered and deferred (needs per-clone git config, crosses slicer's no-git-write boundary). New tests/test_merge.py incl. a real two-branch git merge with no log conflict. 565 tests + slicer check + git diff --check pass.

Added 'slicer note ID [--text/--file/--stdin]' appending a dated paragraph (**YYYY-MM-DD** — text) to Slice.notes via new ops.add_note; renders in show and the slice file (unlike done --note, which is log-only). Requires a promoted item (no_slice error otherwise); blank rejected. TUI editing/adding of notes split to S63. New tests/test_note.py (6 tests); README/getting-started/agents docs updated. 571 tests + slicer check + git diff --check pass.

Added 'slicer status': composes the next item, the stats census, and the blocked edges into one text view and one --json payload {next, census, blocked}. Pure composition of ops.next_item + a shared _census() helper (extracted from cmd_stats so the two cannot drift); no new state. Not a TUI dashboard (per boundary). New tests/test_status.py (5 tests); README + getting-started updated. 576 tests + slicer check + git diff --check pass.
Render an HTML roadmap file alongside the markdown

main() now reuses a module-level cached parser (_cached_parser) instead of calling build_parser() on every invocation; parse_args writes only its namespace so one instance is safe. build_parser() stays uncached for tests/fresh use; --root SUPPRESS and set_defaults(func) survive reuse. Full suite dropped from ~12s to ~4.9s (579 tests, build once not ~780x). New tests/test_parser_cache.py (perf guard + --root-both-sides reuse + fresh build_parser). slicer check + git diff --check pass.

find now reports where each item matched: per-field matching (_field_text/_find_match/_snippet) replaces the single-blob _search_text; text adds an indented 'matched in <field>: <snippet>' line under each row, and --json carries match:{field,snippet}. Reported field honours --in and stays in the id/title/short_title/findings/body vocabulary. Updated tests/test_find.py (12 tests) + README/getting-started/agents. 581 tests + slicer check + git diff --check pass.

slicer log gains a repeatable --item ID filter, applied before the existing timestamp sort and --limit so the limit counts the scoped set; permissive (unknown/purged id yields no rows, empty reports 'no history for <ids>'). Four tests in test_cli.py (single, repeated, composes-with-limit, no-history); README + agents docs updated. 585 tests + slicer check + git diff --check pass.

History now records what changed, not just that it did: set entries log per-field old→new (importance 2→3, size M→S) via a compact _fmt note; log gains a repeatable --action filter (composes with the --item filter delivered in S64). Section/prose body edits stay heading-only and the git allowlist is untouched, per the slice boundary (bodies remain in git). Updated set-note tests in test_ops/test_batch; new log --action tests; README + agents docs. 588 tests + slicer check + git diff --check pass.

Added 'slicer deps [ID] [--format mermaid]': with no id, every unblocked open item ranked by effective score; with an id, its waits-on / blocked-by (unfinished) / dependents (text + --json); --format mermaid renders a graph TD diagram (whole graph or edges around ID) that displays in GitHub PRs. Pure composition of existing graph.py helpers (dependents reverse index, blocked_by, effective_scores) + a new graph.mermaid(); no new state, git untouched. New tests/test_deps.py (4 tests); README + agents docs. 592 tests + slicer check + git diff --check pass.
